definitions.nearest: Euclidean RGB nearest palette; exact ties follow sorted RGB palette order; alpha and hidden transparent RGB unchanged. This is an independent baseline, not a claimed provider implementation.
definitions.edges: Each horizontal or vertical edge counted once; both endpoints must be alpha 255 in both images. Collapsed means distinct control RGB becomes equal comparison RGB. Geometry differences are separate.
definitions.gearStandingPalette: Exact RGB membership in the approved same-facing isolated standing art, not independently labeled material ownership.
